tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// tshe dpag med la bstod pa bzhugs// ༄༅// sna tshogs 'dab rgyas chu skyes lte bar bsil zer can steng du// lhun po ltar brjid 'od zer cher 'phros pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /bdud rtsis yongs gang lhung bzed legs 'dzin mnyam gzhag phyag rgya can// tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med mgon gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// ༈ //'di la ma dmigs srid la mi smon zhing*// bdag la ma chags stong nyid snying rje yis// srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' gnyis rnam bsal nas// sku gsum mngon du byed pa'i theg chen lam// ༈ //yan lag drug cu ldan pa'i gsung dbyangs kyis// yon po'i gzhung lugs rnam par sun phyung nas// yin par nges pa'i chos don ston mdzad cing*// yun du 'gro la rnam par gsal gyur cig/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
